BILLING_PROFILE_PAGE.ADDRESS_HINT: Optional — many subscribers have no address to state, and a subscription is never refused for the want of one.
BILLING_PROFILE_PAGE.ADDRESS_LINE2_PLACE: Second line, if there is one
BILLING_PROFILE_PAGE.COMPLETE_HINT: Changes here appear on documents issued from now on. Invoices already sent keep the details they were issued with.
BILLING_PROFILE_PAGE.DESCRIPTION: The name, contact and address every invoice and credit note for this organization is addressed to.
BILLING_PROFILE_PAGE.DISPLAY_NAME_HINT: Optional. Falls back to the legal name.
BILLING_PROFILE_PAGE.EDIT_HINT: Editing this never changes an invoice that has already been issued.
BILLING_PROFILE_PAGE.EMAIL_HINT: Where invoices, trial invoices and credit notes are emailed.
BILLING_PROFILE_PAGE.EMAIL_LANGUAGE_HINT: The language subscription change and cancellation emails are sent in. Use a language your email templates exist in — a language with no template means no email. Empty means en-US.
BILLING_PROFILE_PAGE.INCOMPLETE: This profile is not complete yet.
BILLING_PROFILE_PAGE.LEGAL_NAME_HINT: The name the organization contracts under. This is what a document has to carry.
BILLING_PROFILE_PAGE.MISMATCH_DESCRIPTIO: The address named {{requested}}, and the server answered about {{resolved}}. Naming another organization is honoured for the platform console only, so what is below belongs to your own — check before saving.
BILLING_PROFILE_PAGE.MISMATCH_TITLE: This is not the organization the link asked for.
BILLING_PROFILE_PAGE.SAVED: Saved. Documents issued from now on carry these details.
BILLING_PROFILE_PAGE.SCOPE_HINT: Every organization keeps its own. Saving here changes nothing for any other.
BILLING_PROFILE_PAGE.TAX_REGISTRATION_HI: Printed exactly as entered. Every jurisdiction spells these differently, so nothing here reformats it.
BILLING_PROFILE_PAGE.TITLE: Billing profile
CREATE_PAGE.DESCRIPTION: A guided walkthrough — nothing is created until you review and confirm at the end.
CREATE_PAGE.PARTIAL_DESCRIPTION: {{failures}} Add the missing prices from the plan page.
CREATE_PAGE.PARTIAL_TITLE_one: {{name}} was created, but {{count}} price was not
CREATE_PAGE.PARTIAL_TITLE_other: {{name}} was created, but {{count}} prices were not
CREATE_PAGE.TITLE: Create subscription plan
CREDIT_OFFERS_PAGE.DESCRIPTION: What an organization pays for a meter's credits bought outside any plan: one offer per meter, with its own price, bounds, expiry and spend order.
CREDIT_OFFERS_PAGE.EMPTY: No offers yet. Add one for a catalogue meter to let organizations buy its credits.
CREDIT_OFFERS_PAGE.FORM_HINT: A grant copies the expiry when it is made; the spend order is read live.
CREDIT_OFFERS_PAGE.LOAD_FAILED: The credit offers could not be loaded.
CREDIT_OFFERS_PAGE.SAVE_FAILED: The credit offer could not be saved.
CREDIT_OFFERS_PAGE.SPEND_SUBSCRIPTION_FI: spent after the subscription's allowance and grants
CREDIT_OFFERS_PAGE.TITLE: Credit offers
DISCOUNTS_PAGE.APPLIES_TO_ANY: Applies to any plan and any price.
DISCOUNTS_PAGE.CREATE_FAILED: The discount could not be created.
DISCOUNTS_PAGE.CREATE_HINT: An ordinary code, a free opening month, or a first-year offer — four short steps.
DISCOUNTS_PAGE.DESCRIPTION: Reusable discount codes and time-boxed campaigns are validated at signup and copied onto each subscription.
DISCOUNTS_PAGE.TITLE: Subscription discounts
DISCOUNTS_PAGE.UPDATE_FAILED: The discount could not be updated.
EDIT_PAGE.ARCHIVED_EXPLANATION: Its terms, its prices, their tax and their discounts are all settled. Everyone already subscribed carries on unchanged — they bill from the terms they bought. To sell something like it again, duplicate the plan from its detail page and edit the copy.
EDIT_PAGE.DESCRIPTION: Rewrites what this plan sells. Nothing is saved until you confirm at the end.
EDIT_PAGE.DESCRIPTION_SUBSCRIBED: Saving creates a new version for new subscribers. Everyone already subscribed keeps the terms and price they bought.
EDIT_PAGE.DISCOUNT_SAVED_DESCRIPTION: New subscriptions and future moves onto this price use it; everyone already on it keeps their snapshot.
EDIT_PAGE.TERMS_EXTENDED_DESCRIPTION: New subscriptions use it now. Existing subscribers are being emailed and move to it at their next renewal at least 7 days away.
EDIT_PAGE.NOT_FOUND_HINT: It may belong to another organization, or no longer exists.
EDIT_PAGE.NOT_LOADED: This plan could not be loaded.
EDIT_PAGE.PARTIAL_DESCRIPTION: {{failures}} Add them from the plan page.
EDIT_PAGE.PARTIAL_TITLE_one: Changes saved, but {{count}} price was not added
EDIT_PAGE.PARTIAL_TITLE_other: Changes saved, but {{count}} prices were not added
EDIT_PAGE.PRICE_RETIRED_DESCRIPTION: It is no longer offered. Anyone already on it keeps their terms and renewals.
EDIT_PAGE.RETIRE_FAILED: The price could not be retired
EDIT_PAGE.TAX_SAVED_DESCRIPTION: New subscriptions will use this tax configuration; existing subscriptions keep their snapshot.
EDIT_PAGE.TITLE: Edit {{name}}
INVOICES_PAGE.AMOUNTS_WARNING: These figures do not add up on their own. That happens on charges taken before the full breakdown was recorded; the total is what was actually charged.
INVOICES_PAGE.DESCRIPTION: Every document this application has issued: invoices, trial invoices and credit notes, with the figures each was issued on.
INVOICES_PAGE.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The PDF could not be downloaded.
INVOICES_PAGE.EMPTY: No documents match these filters yet. A document appears within seconds of a payment confirming, a trial starting, or a refund being settled.
INVOICES_PAGE.MAIL_NO_RECIPIENT: The document is ready, but no billing contact is on file to email it to.
INVOICES_PAGE.MAIL_UNCONFIRMED: The document is ready, but its email could not be confirmed sent. Resending here is disabled — an unconfirmed publish may already have reached the subscriber, and resending it needs a person to check first, not a click.
INVOICES_PAGE.RENDER_FAILED: Rendering did not succeed after every attempt. Retry once the underlying issue is fixed.
INVOICES_PAGE.TITLE: Invoices & credit notes
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.ADDRESS_LINE2_PLAC: Second line, if there is one
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.BRANDING_HINT: The layout is fixed for every tenant. Only the logo and these two colors change — and only for documents issued after they are saved; a document already sent keeps the branding it was issued with.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.CONSOLE_ONLY: Accepted from the platform console only — an invoice names a seller in law.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.DESCRIPTION: The legal identity this tenant issues its invoices and credit notes under.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.INHERITED_HINT: Every tenant on this deployment shares that identity. Set one here so this tenant's documents name the company that is actually selling.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.INHERITED_TITLE: Issuing under the deployment's configured identity.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.LEGAL_NAME_HINT: The registered name of the selling entity, as it must appear on an invoice.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.LOGO_HINT: PNG, JPEG or SVG, under {{size}} KB. Without one, documents show this name as text instead — a missing or unreadable logo never blocks a document.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.LOGO_TYPE_DESCRIPT: Upload a PNG, JPEG or SVG.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.LOGO_UPLOAD_FAILED: The logo could not be uploaded
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.NO_SELLER_HINT: A paid subscription cannot start until a seller is named, because an invoice has to state who issued it.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.OWN_HINT: Changes appear on documents issued from now on. Invoices already sent keep the seller they were issued with.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.OWN_TITLE: This tenant issues under its own identity.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.PAYMENT_INSTRUCTIO: Printed verbatim under the totals on every document.
Bank details, terms, a remittance reference.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.PROVIDER_CHANGED: This provider will be used for new subscriptions. Existing subscriptions will continue using their current provider.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.PROVIDER_HINT: Which provider a new subscription is routed through at creation. Existing subscriptions keep whichever provider they were created with — changing this never moves them.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.PROVIDER_NOT_READY: The selected payment provider isn't ready yet — fix its configuration first.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.PROVIDER_SET_UP: Set this up on the Payment Providers page before selecting it here.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.SAVED: Saved. Documents issued from now on name this seller.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.SUPPORT_EMAIL_HINT: Where a subscriber replies about a charge.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.TAX_REGISTRATION_H: The seller's own registration. Required in some jurisdictions and meaningless in others, so nothing here insists on it.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.TITLE: Merchant profile
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.TRADING_NAME_HINT: Optional. Falls back to the legal name.
MERCHANT_PROFILE_PAGE.UPLOAD_URL_FAILED: Could not get an upload URL.
METER_CATALOGUE_PAGE.DESCRIPTION: The meters this tenant counts, named once so plans and credit offers refer to the same thing. A meter authored inside a plan joins the catalogue when the plan is saved.
METER_CATALOGUE_PAGE.EMPTY: No meters yet. Add one here, or save a plan with a meter and it appears.
METER_CATALOGUE_PAGE.FORM_HINT: Identity and counting only. Prices, allowances and expiry belong to the plan or the credit offer that sells it.
METER_CATALOGUE_PAGE.LOAD_FAILED: The meter catalogue could not be loaded.
METER_CATALOGUE_PAGE.SAVE_FAILED: The meter could not be saved.
METER_CATALOGUE_PAGE.TITLE: Meter catalogue
PLAN_DETAIL_PAGE.ARCHIVED_EXPLANATION: It cannot be subscribed to, changed onto, or edited, and it does not appear in your customers’ choices. Everyone already subscribed carries on unchanged — they bill from the terms they bought, so renewals, usage, entitlements and invoices are unaffected. Archiving cannot be undone; duplicate the plan to build a replacement.
PLAN_DETAIL_PAGE.NOT_FOUND_HINT: It may belong to another organization, or no longer exists.
PLAN_DETAIL_PAGE.NOT_LOADED: This plan could not be loaded.
PLAN_DETAIL_PAGE.NO_PRICE: No price yet — subscribers cannot check out until one exists.
PLAN_DETAIL_PAGE.NO_PRICE_ARCHIVED: This plan was archived without a price, so nothing was ever sold on it.
PLAN_DETAIL_PAGE.PRICE_RETIRED_DESCRIPTI: It is no longer offered. Anyone already on it keeps their terms and renewals.
PLAN_DETAIL_PAGE.RESET_CARRY_FORWARD: Resets each period, carrying up to {{cap}} unused
PLAN_DETAIL_PAGE.RESET_PERIODIC: Resets with the plan allowance period
PLAN_DETAIL_PAGE.RETIRE_FAILED: The price could not be retired
PLAN_LIST_PAGE.ARCHIVED_DESCRIPTION: {{name}} is off the menu. Everyone already on it carries on unchanged.
PLAN_LIST_PAGE.DESCRIPTION: What your tenant sells — configure once here, then subscribe organizations to it from your own product.
PLAN_LIST_PAGE.EMPTY_ACTIVE_BODY: Every plan in this scope has been archived.
PLAN_LIST_PAGE.EMPTY_ARCHIVED_BODY: Plans you take off the menu will be kept here, and stay readable.
PLAN_LIST_PAGE.EMPTY_FILTERED_BODY: Try a different name or code, or clear the filters.
PLAN_LIST_PAGE.EMPTY_NONE_BODY: Create your first plan to start selling subscriptions.
PLAN_LIST_PAGE.SCOPE_ORGANIZATION: Showing this organization's own plans alongside the tenant-wide ones.
PLAN_LIST_PAGE.SCOPE_TENANT: Showing tenant-wide plans. Choose an organization to see plans scoped to it.
PLAN_LIST_PAGE.SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: Search name, code, family, or description
PLAN_LIST_PAGE.TITLE: Subscription plans
PLAN_LIST_PAGE.TRY_LOADING_AGAIN: Try loading the plan list again.
CREDIT_OFFERS_PAGE.PACKS_HINT: Fixed-size bundles at their own price per credit, in {{currency}}. Expiry, tax and spend order are the offer's.
